units.translation: Why did you yoke her to these things, having found her erring in misfortunes?
Shamefully, with the veils of the councilors.
Taking in robes with black-horned [something].
And in an endless [robe] she strikes, having bound the man with a cunning robe.
I would wish to obtain the fateful noose (I corrected to προπρό) in hangings.
I settled blind hopes in them.
Having dipped a double-edged sword in slaughters.
And in linen robes a rent will fall.
And straightway a ship struck a bronze-tipped prow against a ship.
When the sea in midday resting-places – may it sleep, having fallen.
And he falls into a watery vessel.
And I will quickly cast hot-minded [things] upon the ground.
Falling heavily in women's houses.
I place these things in the middle.
He seats this prophet as the fourth on the throne.
He will cast mortal-destroying stains upon the land.
But do not cast in my places either bloody whetstones.
Before setting foot on this miry land.
Having set mortals before [him] in pity.
I will place this man in a roaring oven.
Nourishing the spirit with torches in festivities.
Wishing to inquire into fate in the need of fortune.
In every matter there is nothing worse than bad company.

Neither in upbringing, nor when he had reached youth, nor in the gathering of the beard's hair did Justice look upon him and deem him worthy, nor in the distress of his fatherland do I think that she now stands near him.
A deity of spirit, changeable in a long-lasting turn of fortune.
The city, in fair weather and in storm, did not take in the bilge-water with many blows.
In the end of strife.
Raving in ruin.
And in sleep there drips before the heart pain that remembers misery.
And in the absence of eyes all Aphrodite is gone.
And in dreams, by the thin rushing of a gnat, I was awakened, they crying out.
One should bless the life that ends in dear prosperity.
Not fitting to stand by in laments.
As in the turn of battle.
The seed-corn rejoices in the birth-pangs of the bud.
Swift [are] the griefs that await some in light, others in the space between darkness, lingering.
In your toils they greatly luxuriate.
Ares brandishing missiles in the work.
In what storms – we are whirled about.
She herself held out her breast in the dream.
Adding measure in the race.
And he touched his hand in battle.
And in this matter I was appointed to speak.
Nourishing nothing in the light (?) of the heart.
And he calls those who hear nothing in the midst of a hard-fought whirlpool.
Revering not doing wrong in the division.
Let war be outside, in which there will be a terrible love of glory.
Rejoice in the righteous ordinances of wealth.
Now having a backward-turning face in prayers.
And do not become a drag in speech.
And they will find many at midday.
And pray in an ambush without bounds.
Neither in evils nor in dear prosperity.
Often in evils he sets upright the helpless one.
Rejoice in evils nevertheless.
For we will not betray our dearest ones in evils.
The youthful insolence of mortals in evils.
I do not revere insolence in evils.
Having been taught in evils.
Not to be angry at the gods in evils.
If someone softens the heart in due season.
